scenes.title: The plan
scenes.vo: Here's the plan. First, the key ideas. Then, a worked example, step by step. Then, your checklist. And finally, a three-question quiz.
scenes.cap: Here's the plan. First, the key ideas. Then, a worked example, step by step. Then, your checklist. And finally, a three-question quiz.

scenes.title: Key ideas
scenes.vo: First, Deploy: due diligence done times before-signing checklist times test amount times journal row (protocol, chain, contracts, amount, entry, thesis, kill rules, approvals). Next, Monitor: daily health factor/pegs/ranges/incidents; weekly P and L versus benchmark, harvest, revoke; monthly register review. Then, Respond: pre-written actions for each trigger (see Module 11.5 for incidents). And finally, Review: net return after all costs versus benchmark; simplify anything you can't explain in one sentence.

scenes.title: Worked example
scenes.vo: Position: U.S.D.C. supply, Protocol Y, Arbitrum. Amount or date: $10,000 times 2026-09-01. Thesis: about 5% from real borrow demand. Kill rules: Utilisation > 95% for 48h; oracle or collateral change; any incident. Approvals: U.S.D.C. to Protocol Y pool, limited to $10,000. Weekly: Interest earned, utilisation, governance notes.
